claim_text: Chronic kidney disease can alter vitamin D metabolism and calcium-phosphate regulation; vitamin D supplementation in this setting requires assessment of renal status and relevant biochemical context rather than a generic wellness dose.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsafe supplementation and ensure clinical context is considered.

population.other_context: People with kidney disease considering vitamin D supplementation.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin D Health Professional Fact Sheet provides general vitamin D metabolism and safety context.
limitations: CKD-specific treatment may involve active vitamin D analogues and nephrology protocols not covered by this general source.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
